verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a REST API reference that describes types, paths and payloads for each operation, but nothing in the evidence says a machine-readable spec (OpenAPI or equivalent) can be downloaded. A probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on every one. A human-readable reference is only adjacent to a downloadable machine-readable spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
